SELECT p.publisher_name,
       COUNT(*) AS heroes,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS null_weights,
       MIN(s.weight_kg) AS min_weight,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(s.weight_kg) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnumeric_weights,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_colour_eyes
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN main.colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
GROUP BY p.publisher_name

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(dc.weight_kg, 0))) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM main.superhero AS dc
JOIN main.publisher AS dc_publisher ON dc_publisher.id = dc.publisher_id
JOIN main.colour AS dc_eye ON dc_eye.id = dc.eye_colour_id
WHERE dc_publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND dc_eye.colour IN (
    SELECT marvel_eye.colour
    FROM main.superhero AS marvel
    JOIN main.publisher AS marvel_publisher ON marvel_publisher.id = marvel.publisher_id
    JOIN main.colour AS marvel_eye ON marvel_eye.id = marvel.eye_colour_id
    WHERE marvel_publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  )
LIMIT 1
